Use the video's timeline in seconds. Be concrete: nouns a segmentation model could track. Rate each checkpoint's visibility honestly: a checkpoint you know only from the narration is narration_only, even if the step surely happened. One step per place or part: when the hands move to a different edge, side, corner or part, start a new step, even if the action repeats, so that skipping any one place shows as a missing step. Only steps the hands perform on the task: leave out title cards, screenshots, on-screen text, graphics or animations drawn over the video, close-ups that only show a label, and pointing at parts.

checkpoint_visibility.description: clear: the checkpoint is plainly visible in the frames; subtle: visible only briefly, partly, small or occluded; narration_only: known from the speech, not visible

evidence_s.description: the second in this video where the checkpoint is best seen

objects.description: parts and tools involved, as concrete noun phrases a segmentation model can track

observable_checkpoint.description: what a camera can see that shows the step was done
